title: Your Biggest Module Might Be Your Smallest Build Problem
summary: Amit Kumar proposes ranking dependency refactors by elapsed time saved across frequent builds, then giving an agent one consumer to migrate behind a smaller API. An iOS team can require warm-cache before-and-after logs, an interface-breaking compile check, and a sign-out test; the Feed and AccountServices example is illustrative, not a measured production result.
takeaway: Give the agent timings and a dependency graph, narrow one consumer’s interface, and review removed build tasks alongside compile-time and runtime checks before expanding the migration.
